g.text: Sweep order of the vector distance transform
In each sub-scan every object voxel takes the shortest of the 7 candidates behind the scan
(a neighbor's vector plus the offset to it), replacing its own vector only when the candidate is
strictly shorter. Outside the image is object. Two passes; the sub-scan order of pass 2 mirrors pass 1.
